summary: V2.47.251 fixes the Home Wide Desktop portal grid so the current Home body uses the same 1440px shared shell as the other P01 subsites. The main column now consumes remaining wide-screen space while the right rail stays bounded at 340px. This is a bounded presentation-only correction to the V2.47.250 Wide Desktop closure; IA, Body Grammar, data model, schema, auth, updater mechanism and Production are unchanged. OWNER_DIRECT_RELEASE applies; Owner Preview remains post-release and Production remains Owner-manual.
